A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Point-Cache research. All 24 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables and supplementary material, support comparison. The 11 supplementary pages match exactly in text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original recognition, corruption-robustness, generalization, memory and throughput experiments, together with ablations and supplementary results.

after.justification: v3.pdf retains these original empirical results in the main text and supplementary material.

M1.justification: The global/local caches, entropy-based sample selection, part clustering and prediction procedure remain unchanged. Equations 1–4 and supplementary Algorithm 1 are retained.

E1.justification: Both versions retain ModelNet/ModelNet-C, ScanObjectNN variants and their corruptions, OmniObject3D, Objaverse-LVIS and the supplementary Sim-to-Real evaluations. No dataset or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments. The same zero-shot backbones and cache variants remain; supplementary Table 8 retains MetaSets, PDG and I-OODG, while Table 17 retains Point-NN.

E3.justification: Splits, corruption severity, point counts, metrics, model configurations and evaluation procedures remain unchanged. Section 4.4 corrects αg = αl to βg = βl in the sharpness discussion, matching the existing Figure 4d sweep; its candidate values and plotted experiment are unchanged.

E4.justification: The cache-size, part-count, balance-factor and sharpness ablations are retained. Corruption tests, online-inference analyses, entropy–accuracy plots and qualitative examples also remain unchanged, including those in the supplement.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point estimates and averaging practices. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted findings and qualitative examples are unchanged throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 1 reports 53.70% average ModelNet-C accuracy for ULIP with the hierarchical cache in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, method equations and supplementary cache-size calculations are unchanged. The sharpness-symbol correction does not introduce a new definition, derivation or theoretical result.

C1.justification: The claims of training-free, dynamic hierarchical adaptation, recognition of known and unseen classes, broad backbone compatibility and low overhead are retained. The shortened conclusion preserves these contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of cache benefits, entropy reduction and computational overhead remain unchanged, as do the supplementary comparison caveats. Removing the concluding plan to explore detection and segmentation changes the future-work outlook, without revising current applicability claims or limitations.

D1.justification: Section 4.4 corrects the documented equality for the sharpness parameters from αg = αl to βg = βl, resolving a technical inconsistency. Default hyperparameters, hardware, precision, backbone details, text templates and code-access information are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: The bibliography contains the same works, and the related-work discussion and supplementary positioning against other cache models are unchanged. Reference movement between pages is layout reflow.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited edits to abstract punctuation, corrects the sharpness symbols, updates acknowledgments and condenses the conclusion, including removing its future-work sentence. The section structure and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is reduced in size, and text and several figures shift vertically. The shortened conclusion fits on page 8, with subsequent acknowledgment and reference reflow. Figure content, table structures and supplementary layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting the sharpness-parameter equality in Section 4.4 removes an inconsistency between the experimental description and Figure 4d, modestly improving technical clarity. The remaining changes are limited editorial and layout adjustments; the method, empirical evidence and supplementary material retain their previous substance.
